risks: New trade restrictions and tariffs have significantly impacted AXT's revenue and operations.
Revenue declined to $17.4 million in the third quarter of 2023 from $39.7 million in the first quarter of 2022.
Restrictions from the Chinese government could disrupt production and lead to loss of sales.
Power shortages in China could cause temporary closures and ruin work in process, impacting revenue and margins.

The China central government has tightened control over hazardous chemicals, which could result in orders to shut down our raw material companies and have a material adverse effect on our financial结果已

growth_drivers: Tongmei's InP wafer substrates are in high demand for high-speed optical data transmission in data centers using artificial intelligence.
Revenue increased $37.2 million, or 99.6%, to $74.5 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
risks: Tongmei faces uncertainty in obtaining export permits for indium phosphide substrates to the U.S., which could delay shipments.
New tariffs and export controls have significantly reduced revenue from North American sales.

growth_drivers: Revenue from customers in China increased by 41.1% in 2024.
risks: Tongmei may not receive necessary China permits to export wafer substrates due to political tensions.
Revenue from customers in North America decreased by 77.5% due to export permit requirements on InP established by China.
AXT recorded a valuation allowance against its net deferred tax assets due to uncertainty about future profitability.
The company reviews accounts receivable at least quarterly and provides an allowance for credit losses.

growth_drivers: Revenue related to indium phosphide based lasers market in China more than doubled in Q2 from the prior quarter.
Revenue opportunity for indium phosphide is on track to more than triple by the end of 2026.
AXT is set to become the largest indium phosphide producer, doubling its capacity in 2027.
Q2 2026 revenue was $46.9 million, the highest in AXT's history.
The company is confident in recognizing $66 million in Q3 revenue and sees potential for significant upside.
The company is targeting $60 million in quarterly indium phosphide capacity by the end of the year.
Backlog is growing beyond $100 million and covers demand through 2027.
China is currently more than 50% of AXT's revenue and expected to be 40% to 60% in the future.
The company is targeting a number beginning with 5, indicating significant growth.
AXT is a dominant player in indium phosphide and expects significant growth from long-term supply agreements.
risks: Demand is moving faster than we can move, but we are doing great to keep up.
